About AI

Understanding the technology that\'s reshaping our world — from its origins to the infinite possibilities ahead.

What is Artificial Intelligence?

Artificial Intelligence refers to machines that mimic cognitive functions typically associated with the human mind — learning, problem-solving, perception, and language understanding.

Unlike traditional software that follows explicit instructions, AI systems learn from data, identify patterns, and make predictions or decisions with minimal human intervention. This capability transforms every industry from healthcare to entertainment.

The Journey

1950

The Turing Test

Alan Turing proposes a test for machine intelligence, laying the theoretical foundation for AI.

1956

Birth of AI

John McCarthy coins the term "Artificial Intelligence" at the Dartmouth Conference.

1997

Deep Blue

IBM's Deep Blue defeats chess champion Garry Kasparov, a watershed moment for AI.

2012

Deep Learning

AlexNet wins ImageNet, sparking the deep learning revolution with neural networks.

2016

AlphaGo

DeepMind's AlphaGo defeats Go world champion Lee Sedol, a milestone in strategic AI.

2020

GPT-3

OpenAI releases GPT-3, demonstrating unprecedented language understanding and generation.

2022

Generative AI Boom

ChatGPT, DALL-E, and Midjourney bring generative AI to mainstream consciousness.

Future

AGI

Artificial General Intelligence — machines that can perform any intellectual task a human can.
